import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 16))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#1a1a2e')
ax.set_facecolor('#1a1a2e')

# Color scheme by category
COLORS = {
    'data-layer': '#4a9eff',
    'compute-layer': '#4ae08a',
    'serving-layer': '#ff9f43',
    'observability-layer': '#ff6b6b',
}
EDGE_COLORS = {
    'primary': '#e0e0e0',
    'feedback': '#ff6b6b',
    'lineage': '#b388ff',
}

# Node positions - laid out as directed pipeline left-to-right with branching
positions = {
    'data_platform':    (1.5, 5.5),
    'feature_store':    (4.0, 5.5),
    'training_cluster': (7.0, 5.5),
    'model_registry':   (10.0, 5.5),
    'inference_online':  (13.0, 7.5),
    'inference_offline': (13.0, 3.5),
    'ab_experiment':    (16.0, 5.5),
    'monitoring':       (19.0, 5.5),
    'version_control':  (7.0, 1.5),
}

nodes = [
    {'id': 'data_platform',    'label': 'Data Platform\n(Spark / Flink)',          'category': 'data-layer',         'criticality': 9},
    {'id': 'feature_store',    'label': 'Feature Store',                           'category': 'data-layer',         'criticality': 8},
    {'id': 'training_cluster', 'label': 'Training Cluster\n(GPU)',                 'category': 'compute-layer',      'criticality': 10},
    {'id': 'model_registry',   'label': 'Model Registry',                          'category': 'compute-layer',      'criticality': 8},
    {'id': 'inference_online',  'label': 'Inference Service\n(Online / Real-time)', 'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 9},
    {'id': 'inference_offline', 'label': 'Inference Service\n(Offline / Batch)',    'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 7},
    {'id': 'ab_experiment',    'label': 'A/B Experiment\nPlatform',                'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 8},
    {'id': 'monitoring',       'label': 'Monitoring &\nAlerting',                  'category': 'observability-layer', 'criticality': 9},
    {'id': 'version_control',  'label': 'Version Control\n& Data Lineage',         'category': 'observability-layer', 'criticality': 7},
]

sub_components = {
    'data_platform': 'Spark · Flink · Kafka',
    'feature_store': 'Redis · Hive · Registry',
    'training_cluster': 'A100 · Horovod · HPO',
    'model_registry': 'MLflow · S3 Artifacts',
    'inference_online': 'TensorRT · Triton · LB',
    'inference_offline': 'Spark Batch · Airflow',
    'ab_experiment': 'Traffic Split · Stats',
    'monitoring': 'Prometheus · Grafana · PD',
    'version_control': 'DVC · Git · Lineage DB',
}

edges = [
    {'source': 'data_platform',    'target': 'feature_store',    'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 12.5, 'label': 'Raw → Features'},
    {'source': 'feature_store',    'target': 'training_cluster', 'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 8.0,  'label': 'Training Data'},
    {'source': 'training_cluster', 'target': 'model_registry',   'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 2.5,  'label': 'Trained Models'},
    {'source': 'model_registry',   'target': 'inference_online',  'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 1.8,  'label': 'Deploy (Online)'},
    {'source': 'model_registry',   'target': 'inference_offline', 'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 3.2,  'label': 'Deploy (Batch)'},
    {'source': 'inference_online',  'target': 'ab_experiment',    'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 5.0,  'label': 'Predictions (RT)'},
    {'source': 'inference_offline', 'target': 'ab_experiment',    'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 4.0,  'label': 'Predictions (Batch)'},
    {'source': 'ab_experiment',    'target': 'monitoring',        'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 2.0,  'label': 'Metrics & Results'},
    {'source': 'feature_store',    'target': 'inference_online',  'flow_type': 'primary',  'throughput_gbps': 6.0,  'label': 'Online Features'},
    {'source': 'monitoring',       'target': 'data_platform',     'flow_type': 'feedback', 'throughput_gbps': 0.5,  'label': 'Data Quality Alerts'},
    {'source': 'monitoring',       'target': 'training_cluster',  'flow_type': 'feedback', 'throughput_gbps': 0.3,  'label': 'Retrain Trigger'},
    {'source': 'version_control',  'target': 'feature_store',     'flow_type': 'lineage',  'throughput_gbps': 0.1,  'label': 'Feature Versioning'},
    {'source': 'version_control',  'target': 'training_cluster',  'flow_type': 'lineage',  'throughput_gbps': 0.1,  'label': 'Experiment Tracking'},
    {'source': 'version_control',  'target': 'model_registry',    'flow_type': 'lineage',  'throughput_gbps': 0.1,  'label': 'Model Lineage'},
    {'source': 'data_platform',    'target': 'version_control',   'flow_type': 'lineage',  'throughput_gbps': 0.2,  'label': 'Data Lineage'},
]

# Draw nodes
for n in nodes:
    x, y = positions[n['id']]
    cat = n['category']
    color = COLORS[cat]
    crit = n['criticality']
    # Size based on criticality
    w = 1.8 + (crit - 7) * 0.15
    h = 1.2 + (crit - 7) * 0.1

    # Glow effect
    for i in range(3, 0, -1):
        glow = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2 - i*0.05, y - h/2 - i*0.05), w + i*0.1, h + i*0.1,
                               boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor=color, alpha=0.05*i,
                               edgecolor='none', zorder=1)
        ax.add_patch(glow)

    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", facecolor=color + '22',
                          edgecolor=color, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(box)

    ax.text(x, y + 0.15, n['label'], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color='white', zorder=6, linespacing=1.2)
    ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.22, sub_components[n['id']], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
            color=color, alpha=0.8, zorder=6, style='italic')

# Draw edges
def get_edge_points(src, tgt, positions):
    sx, sy = positions[src]
    tx, ty = positions[tgt]
    return sx, sy, tx, ty

for e in edges:
    sx, sy, tx, ty = get_edge_points(e['source'], e['target'], positions)
    ft = e['flow_type']
    color = EDGE_COLORS[ft]
    tp = e['throughput_gbps']
    lw = 1.0 + tp * 0.3
    ls = '-' if ft == 'primary' else ('--' if ft == 'lineage' else '-.')
    alpha = 0.9 if ft == 'primary' else 0.7

    # Compute direction for offset from node border
    dx = tx - sx
    dy = ty - sy
    dist = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist

    # Offset start/end to node border
    s_off = 1.0
    t_off = 1.0
    asx = sx + ux * s_off
    asy = sy + uy * s_off
    atx = tx - ux * t_off
    aty = ty - uy * t_off

    # Feedback loops need curved arrows
    if ft == 'feedback':
        if e['target'] == 'data_platform':
            connstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.35"
        else:
            connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.25"
    elif ft == 'lineage':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.2"
    elif e['source'] == 'feature_store' and e['target'] == 'inference_online':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.2"
    else:
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.0"

    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((asx, asy), (atx, aty),
                             connectionstyle=connstyle,
                             arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=18,
                             color=color, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
                             alpha=alpha, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

    # Edge label
    mx = (asx + atx) / 2
    my = (asy + aty) / 2
    # Offset label perpendicular to edge
    perp_x, perp_y = -uy, ux
    offset = 0.25
    if ft == 'feedback':
        offset = 0.45
    elif ft == 'lineage':
        offset = 0.35
    lx = mx + perp_x * offset
    ly = my + perp_y * offset

    label_text = f"{e['label']}  ({tp} Gbps)"
    ax.text(lx, ly, label_text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
            color=color, alpha=0.85, zorder=7,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='#1a1a2e', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8))

# Legend
legend_items = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['data-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['data-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Data Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['compute-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['compute-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Compute Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['serving-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['serving-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Serving Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['observability-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['observability-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Observability Layer'),
]
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
edge_legend = [
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['primary'], lw=2.5, ls='-', label='Primary Data Flow'),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['feedback'], lw=2, ls='-.', label='Feedback Loop'),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['lineage'], lw=2, ls='--', label='Version Control / Lineage'),
]

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(26, 16))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#0f0f1a')
ax.set_facecolor('#0f0f1a')

COLORS = {
    'data-layer': '#4a9eff',
    'compute-layer': '#3ddc84',
    'serving-layer': '#ff9f43',
    'observability-layer': '#ff6b6b',
}
EDGE_COLORS = {
    'primary': '#c8d0da',
    'feedback': '#ff6b6b',
    'lineage': '#b388ff',
}

# Positions: main pipeline flows left→right, branching up/down at inference
positions = {
    'data_platform':    (2.0, 6.0),
    'feature_store':    (5.5, 6.0),
    'training_cluster': (9.5, 6.0),
    'model_registry':   (13.5, 6.0),
    'inference_online':  (17.0, 8.5),
    'inference_offline': (17.0, 3.5),
    'ab_experiment':    (20.5, 6.0),
    'monitoring':       (24.5, 6.0),
    'version_control':  (9.5, 1.0),
}

nodes_data = {
    'data_platform':    {'label': 'Data Platform\n(Spark / Flink)',          'category': 'data-layer',         'criticality': 9,  'sub': 'Spark · Flink · Kafka'},
    'feature_store':    {'label': 'Feature Store',                           'category': 'data-layer',         'criticality': 8,  'sub': 'Redis · Hive · Registry'},
    'training_cluster': {'label': 'Training Cluster\n(GPU)',                 'category': 'compute-layer',      'criticality': 10, 'sub': 'A100 · Horovod · HPO'},
    'model_registry':   {'label': 'Model Registry',                          'category': 'compute-layer',      'criticality': 8,  'sub': 'MLflow · S3 Artifacts'},
    'inference_online':  {'label': 'Inference Service\n(Online / Real-time)', 'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 9,  'sub': 'TensorRT · Triton · LB'},
    'inference_offline': {'label': 'Inference Service\n(Offline / Batch)',    'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 7,  'sub': 'Spark Batch · Airflow'},
    'ab_experiment':    {'label': 'A/B Experiment\nPlatform',                'category': 'serving-layer',      'criticality': 8,  'sub': 'Traffic Split · Stats'},
    'monitoring':       {'label': 'Monitoring &\nAlerting',                  'category': 'observability-layer', 'criticality': 9,  'sub': 'Prometheus · Grafana · PD'},
    'version_control':  {'label': 'Version Control\n& Data Lineage',         'category': 'observability-layer', 'criticality': 7,  'sub': 'DVC · Git · Lineage DB'},
}

edges_data = [
    ('data_platform',    'feature_store',    'primary',  12.5, 'Raw → Features'),
    ('feature_store',    'training_cluster', 'primary',  8.0,  'Training Data'),
    ('training_cluster', 'model_registry',   'primary',  2.5,  'Trained Models'),
    ('model_registry',   'inference_online',  'primary',  1.8,  'Deploy (Online)'),
    ('model_registry',   'inference_offline', 'primary',  3.2,  'Deploy (Batch)'),
    ('inference_online',  'ab_experiment',    'primary',  5.0,  'Predictions (RT)'),
    ('inference_offline', 'ab_experiment',    'primary',  4.0,  'Predictions (Batch)'),
    ('ab_experiment',    'monitoring',        'primary',  2.0,  'Metrics & Results'),
    ('feature_store',    'inference_online',  'primary',  6.0,  'Online Features'),
    ('monitoring',       'data_platform',     'feedback', 0.5,  'Data Quality\nAlerts'),
    ('monitoring',       'training_cluster',  'feedback', 0.3,  'Retrain\nTrigger'),
    ('version_control',  'feature_store',     'lineage',  0.1,  'Feature\nVersioning'),
    ('version_control',  'training_cluster',  'lineage',  0.1,  'Experiment\nTracking'),
    ('version_control',  'model_registry',    'lineage',  0.1,  'Model\nLineage'),
    ('data_platform',    'version_control',   'lineage',  0.2,  'Data\nLineage'),
]

# Draw nodes
for nid, nd in nodes_data.items():
    x, y = positions[nid]
    color = COLORS[nd['category']]
    crit = nd['criticality']
    w = 2.2 + (crit - 7) * 0.18
    h = 1.5 + (crit - 7) * 0.1

    # Soft glow
    for i in range(4, 0, -1):
        glow = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2 - i*0.06, y - h/2 - i*0.06), w + i*0.12, h + i*0.12,
                               boxstyle="round,pad=0.18", facecolor=color, alpha=0.03*i,
                               edgecolor='none', zorder=1)
        ax.add_patch(glow)

    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.18", facecolor=color + '18',
                          edgecolor=color, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(box)

    ax.text(x, y + 0.18, nd['label'], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold',

    ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.25, nd['sub'], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
            color=color, alpha=0.85, zorder=6, style='italic')


def arrow_offset(sx, sy, tx, ty, offset_start=1.1, offset_end=1.1):
    dx = tx - sx
    dy = ty - sy
    dist = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
    ux, uy = dx/dist, dy/dist
    return sx + ux*offset_start, sy + uy*offset_start, tx - ux*offset_end, ty - uy*offset_end


# Edge label position customization to avoid overlap
label_offsets = {}

for src, tgt, ft, tp, label in edges_data:
    sx, sy = positions[src]
    tx, ty = positions[tgt]
    color = EDGE_COLORS[ft]
    lw = max(1.2, 0.8 + tp * 0.32)
    ls = '-' if ft == 'primary' else ('--' if ft == 'lineage' else (0, (4, 3)))
    alpha = 0.9 if ft == 'primary' else 0.7

    asx, asy, atx, aty = arrow_offset(sx, sy, tx, ty)

    # Connection styles
    if ft == 'feedback' and tgt == 'data_platform':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.4"
    elif ft == 'feedback' and tgt == 'training_cluster':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.25"
    elif ft == 'lineage' and src == 'data_platform':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.15"
    elif ft == 'lineage' and tgt == 'feature_store':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.15"
    elif ft == 'lineage' and tgt == 'training_cluster':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.0"
    elif ft == 'lineage' and tgt == 'model_registry':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.15"
    elif src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=-0.15"
    else:
        connstyle = "arc3,rad=0.0"

    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((asx, asy), (atx, aty),
                             connectionstyle=connstyle,
                             arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=18,
                             color=color, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
                             alpha=alpha, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

    # Edge labels positioned carefully
    mx = (asx + atx) / 2
    my = (asy + aty) / 2
    dx = atx - asx
    dy = aty - asy
    dist = np.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2)
    perp_x, perp_y = -dy/dist, dx/dist

    base_off = 0.3
    if ft == 'feedback':
        base_off = 0.6
    elif ft == 'lineage':
        base_off = 0.4

    # Custom offsets for specific edges to avoid collisions
    if src == 'feature_store' and tgt == 'inference_online':
        mx = (sx + tx) / 2 - 0.5
        my = (sy + ty) / 2 + 0.5
        base_off = 0.0
        perp_x, perp_y = 0, 0
    elif ft == 'feedback' and tgt == 'data_platform':
        my += 1.8
        mx -= 2.0
    elif ft == 'feedback' and tgt == 'training_cluster':
        my -= 0.8
        mx += 0.0

    lx = mx + perp_x * base_off
    ly = my + perp_y * base_off

    label_text = f"{label}\n{tp} Gbps"
    ax.text(lx, ly, label_text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
            color=color, alpha=0.9, zorder=7, linespacing=1.1,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', facecolor='#0f0f1a', edgecolor=color+'44', alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.5))

# Legends
legend_nodes = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['data-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['data-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Data Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['compute-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['compute-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Compute Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['serving-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['serving-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Serving Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['observability-layer'] + '44', edgecolor=COLORS['observability-layer'], linewidth=2, label='Observability Layer'),
]
legend_edges = [
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['primary'], lw=3, ls='-', label='Primary Data Flow (solid)'),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['feedback'], lw=2, ls='-.', label='Feedback Loop (dash-dot)'),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=EDGE_COLORS['lineage'], lw=2, ls='--', label='Version Control / Lineage (dashed)'),
]

leg1 = ax.legend(handles=legend_nodes, loc='upper left', fontsize=9, facecolor='#16213e',
                  edgecolor='#3a3a5a', labelcolor='white', title='Node Layers',
                  title_fontproperties={'weight':'bold', 'size':10}, framealpha=0.95)
leg1.get_title().set_color('white')
ax.add_artist(leg1)

leg2 = ax.legend(handles=legend_edges, loc='lower left', fontsize=9, facecolor='#16213e',
                  edgecolor='#3a3a5a', labelcolor='white', title='Edge Types',
                  title_fontproperties={'weight':'bold', 'size':10}, framealpha=0.95)
leg2.get_title().set_color('white')
ax.add_artist(leg2)

# Annotations for encoding
ax.text(0.3, 0.6, 'Node size ∝ Criticality (7–10)  ·  Edge thickness ∝ Throughput (0.1–12.5 Gbps)',
        fontsize=8.5, color='#888899', style='italic')

# Title
ax.text(13.25, 10.8, 'ML Infrastructure Pipeline Architecture', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=24, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=10,
        fontfamily='sans-serif')
ax.text(13.25, 10.2, 'End-to-End Data Flow  ·  Online / Offline Branching  ·  Feedback Loops  ·  Data Lineage Overlay',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11.5, color='#7788aa', zorder=10)

ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 27)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 11.5)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, facecolor='#0f0f1a', bbox_inches='tight')
print("Done")
